name: Evan Shi
headline: Senior Software Engineer · Java, Python, AI applications
location: China (planning to study and work in New Zealand)
summary: Software engineer with 6+ years of experience building backend systems for banking, telecom and healthcare, including three years at State Street in an English-speaking, globally distributed team. Since 2025 I have been designing, building and running my own AI products end to end, from model pipelines to payments and deployment. I'm now preparing for IELTS and plan to study for a master's degree in New Zealand, then continue my career there as a software engineer.

highlights: Built and run two consumer AI SaaS products on my own: product design, frontend, backend, payments, cloud deployment, growth and support.
Designed AI pipelines that combine speech recognition, large language models, OCR and image-editing models; compared models on quality, speed and cost, and improved prompts using real failure cases.
Reduced upload and processing costs by extracting the audio track in the browser and uploading only the audio.
Implemented Stripe subscriptions, credit packs and usage-based top-ups, and iterated on pricing until subscriptions made up about half of paying customers.
Grew organic traffic through SEO content, short-form video and launch platforms. Revenue is public on [this site](/revenue) and verified on TrustMRR.
Lead developer on an institutional digital-asset trading platform built as Spring Cloud Alibaba (Nacos) microservices and deployed on AWS.
Designed and built the trading microservice that integrates with an external custody and trading partner: account and asset queries, order placement, and order and fill status synchronisation.
Kept orders and balances consistent despite asynchronous, high-latency on-chain settlement by using idempotent operations, retries and compensating state updates.
Worked directly with users to turn raw requirements into functional designs, and coordinated with business teams, QA and external vendors through integration and release.
Contributed to other internal systems, working in English with colleagues across regions.
Owned the design and delivery of a billing audit system for a provincial branch of a major mobile operator with more than 10 million subscribers.
Re-architected the legacy system on Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis and Kafka, adding caching, horizontal scaling and Kafka-based alert delivery.
Rebuilt a data push service handling about 5 million messages a day; batching, thread pools and pipeline tuning raised throughput by 40% and resolved garbage-collection issues.
Took part in architecture design, technology selection and code reviews.
Developed a pathology system used by six major hospitals, including integrations with hospital information and laboratory systems (HIS, LIS).
Extended an internal job-scheduling platform based on XXL-Job with adaptive load balancing, Redis priority queues and distributed locks, and ZooKeeper service registration.
Led junior developers and delivered each hospital's releases on schedule.

achievements: Second prize, Lanqiao Cup national programming contest
Open-source Python project with 800+ stars on GitHub (2022)

languages.level: Professional working proficiency; three years in an English-speaking workplace. IELTS Academic in preparation.
